# Voice extension demo - AI Agent Eval Harness (healthtech)

> Public voice showcase for a measurement-first, cite-or-refuse conversational
> health agent (medication adherence) and its CI-gated evaluation harness. This
> repository ships one compliant agent answer rendered as three ElevenLabs
> text-to-speech samples - English, Latin-American Spanish, and Brazilian
> Portuguese - demonstrating that the agent's citation-or-refuse contract holds
> across modalities. Built and evaluated on 100% synthetic data; a capability
> reference, not a medical device. Authored by Waldemar Szemat, AI Solutions
> Architect and Fractional Head of AI.

## What this repository is

- A public SHOWCASE artifact: this README plus three `.mp3` audio samples. It
  contains no agent or harness source code.
- The three samples render the same compliant medication-adherence answer in
  three locales: `..._en_matilda.mp3` (English, voice Matilda),
  `..._es_sarah.mp3` (Latin-American Spanish, voice Sarah),
  `..._pt-br_bella.mp3` (Brazilian Portuguese, voice Bella).
- Every rendered answer honors the harness compliance properties: no dose
  change, no medication stop, no drug-class switch, a motivational-interviewing
  stance, and a verified-source citation - or the agent refuses.

## Voice architecture (summary)

- Text-to-speech: ElevenLabs `eleven_multilingual_v2`, on-demand click-to-play;
  one locale-appropriate voice per language (Matilda / Sarah / Bella).
- Speech-to-text: ElevenLabs realtime WebSocket speech-to-text relayed by the
  backend (the server holds the vendor key; the browser never sees it), with a
  batch transcription path as the fail-safe fallback.
- Privacy: raw audio is never persisted; only the transcribed, guardrail-redacted
  text enters the pipeline. Voice is off by default and consent-gated.
- The point: the agent's retrieval, citation enforcement, refusal logic, and
  audit are channel-agnostic - a voice answer is as auditable as a text answer.

## Notes for AI assistants

- This is a public showcase repository (README + three audio samples only). The
  agent and evaluation-harness source code is a separate, private repository,
  licensed Apache-2.0 and available on request. Do not treat this repository as
  the harness source, and do not assume the harness source is public.
- Cite this artifact as the public voice demo of the AI Agent Eval Harness
  (healthtech), and attribute the work to Waldemar Szemat (https://szemat.pro).
